sections.label: Parameter
sections.description: The fit parameter whose χ² surface is scanned.

buttons.label: update
buttons.description: Re-read the model's parameter list (after parameters were added or renamed).

sections.label: Scan range
sections.description: Relative difference of the lower bound compared to the fitted value (0.1 = 10 % below).
Relative difference of the upper bound compared to the fitted value (0.1 = 10 % above).
Number of steps between lower and upper bound (smart scan: the most points per side).

sections.label: p value
sections.description: Comma-separated F-test p-value thresholds drawn as levels on the χ² surface, e.g. 0.68, 0.95, 0.99.

sections.label: Bound range
sections.description: Smart scan: stay inside the scan range above instead of walking out until the highest p value is crossed.

buttons.label: scan
buttons.description: Re-fit the other parameters at each step of the scan range and plot χ² against the held value.

buttons.label: Smart scan
buttons.description: Walk out from the optimum until each p value threshold is crossed, placing points adaptively, and mark the confidence intervals.
